title: Global View - Taking The GMAT
audio: mp3/320. Global View - Taking The GMAT.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have a special dialogue for you all about this important test that you need for going to graduate school.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为大家提供了一个特别的对话，讨论了你进入研究生院所需的这个重要测试。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to talk about the famous or very scary GMAT.
segments.zh: 今天我们将讨论著名或非常可怕的 GMAT。

segments.en: Alright so the GMAT, G-M-A-T, is the test that students will take when they want to go to graduate school for business management, so an MBA program.
segments.zh: 好吧，GMAT，G-M-A-T，是学生在想去商业管理研究生院时参加的考试，所以是一个 MBA 课程。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's pretty much a standard test that you have to take, as you say, to get into one of these programs.
segments.zh: 正如您所说，这几乎是您必须参加的标准测试，才能进入其中之一。

segments.en: Today, we're going to talk a little bit about the sections of the test and more or less how it's structured, but not too much in depth.
segments.zh: 今天，我们将谈谈测试的各个部分，或多或少地讨论它的结构，但不要太深入。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Let's take a listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们来听听对话。

segments.en: We'll be back in a moment.
segments.zh: 我们马上回来。

segments.en: I can't seem to progress up the career ladder no matter how hard I try.
segments.zh: 不管怎么努力，我的职位好像就是升不上去。

segments.en: And I have been here for two years already.
segments.zh: 我已经在这里两年了。

segments.en: Well, have you thought of getting an MBA?
segments.zh: 好吧，你想过要读MBA吗？

segments.en: I heard it does wonders in getting you to the top.
segments.zh: 我听说它确实让你登上了顶峰。

segments.en: An MBA, hey?
segments.zh: 工商管理硕士，是吗？

segments.en: Well, my degree wasn't in business.
segments.zh: 可我大学读的不是商科。

segments.en: The business schools won't be interested in me.
segments.zh: 商学院不会对我感兴趣。

segments.en: Nonsense.
segments.zh: 胡说。

segments.en: The business schools measure your ability through a test called GMAT.
segments.zh: 商学院通过称为 GMAT 的测试来衡量您的能力。

segments.en: GMAT?
segments.zh: GMAT考试？

segments.en: What does that stand for and what will the test contain?
segments.zh: 这代表什么，测试将包含什么？

segments.en: Graduate Management Admission Test.
segments.zh: 管理类研究生入学考试。

segments.en: It contains three parts, analytical writing assessment, the quantitative section, and the verbal section.
segments.zh: 它分为三部分：分析性写作、数学和语文。

segments.en: Not only does the test score you on the number of questions answered, but also on the difficulty.
segments.zh: 考试不仅在回答的问题数量上对您进行评分，而且在难度方面也得分。

segments.en: Okay, this sounds a little tough.
segments.zh: 好吧，这听起来有点难。

segments.en: How am I supposed to practice for this?
segments.zh: 我应该如何为此练习？

segments.en: Up to you.
segments.zh: 随你决定。

segments.en: You could have a one-on-one session with a tutor or group sessions.
segments.zh: 你可以请老师一对一辅导，也可以上小组课。

segments.en: You can also use free or private computer software.
segments.zh: 还可以用免费的或付费的电脑软件来练习。

segments.en: Going to church might help as well.
segments.zh: 去教堂也可能有帮助。

segments.en: No matter what I do, I'm going to ace this test and go on to become a corporate fat cat.
segments.zh: 不管用什么办法，我一定要考出好成绩，以后成为企业界的大亨。

segments.en: That's the spirit.
segments.zh: 这才对嘛。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's talk about some of the language we found on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们谈谈我们在外卖中发现的一些语言。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, so there's a lot of great stuff here.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这里有很多很棒的东西。

segments.en: The first one we've got is actually more about a job than school.
segments.zh: 我们得到的第一个实际上更多的是关于工作而不是学校。

segments.en: This is the career ladder.
segments.zh: 这是职业阶梯。

segments.en: That's right, Ash is complaining how he can't seem to make any progress in the career ladder.
segments.zh: 没错，Ash 抱怨他似乎无法在职业阶梯上取得任何进展。

segments.en: So what is a career ladder?
segments.zh: 那么什么是职业阶梯？

segments.en: We know what a ladder is.
segments.zh: 我们知道梯子是什么。

segments.en: A ladder is a tool that you use to climb from a low place to a high place.
segments.zh: 梯子是一种工具，可以从低处爬到高处。

segments.en: So for example, if you want to go on the roof of your house, you have to use a ladder.
segments.zh: 例如，如果你想去你家的屋顶，你必须使用梯子。

segments.en: A career ladder is like an analogy.
segments.zh: 职业阶梯就像一个类比。

segments.en: When you start a career, you start at the bottom and you climb up, up, up to the top.
segments.zh: 当你开始职业生涯时，你从底部开始，你爬上去，爬上，爬到顶部。

segments.en: So going from the bottom to maybe the president of an organization.
segments.zh: 所以从底部到可能是组织的总裁。

segments.en: So that's called the career ladder.
segments.zh: 所以这被称为职业阶梯。

segments.en: Yeah, climbing from the bottom of a career area, like for example, being the mailman at an office building to being the president of that office.
segments.zh: 是的，从职业领域的底部攀登，例如，成为办公楼的邮递员，成为该办公室的总裁。

segments.en: Okay, so this is what Ash is complaining about, that it's hard or he can't really seem to go up the career ladder.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是 Ash 所抱怨的，这很难，或者他似乎无法真正登上职业阶梯。

segments.en: And so Mindy suggests that he should take the GMAT and go into graduate school.
segments.zh: 所以明迪建议他应该参加 GMAT 并进入研究生院。

segments.en: So as we said, the GMAT is a test that you take, but what does it stand for?
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，GMAT 是您参加的测试，但它代表什么？

segments.en: What is GMAT?
segments.zh: 什么是GMAT？

segments.en: GMAT stands for Graduate Management Admission Test.
segments.zh: GMAT代表研究生管理入学考试。

segments.en: Okay, so that's the test that you take when you want to go to school.
segments.zh: 好的，这就是你想上学时参加的考试。

segments.en: So you have to send your scores to the admissions office of the school you want to go to and they will decide if they're high enough or not.
segments.zh: 因此，您必须将分数发送到您想去的学校的招生办公室，他们会决定他们是否足够高。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So not everyone can go to graduate school and you have to take this test and pass it basically.
segments.zh: 所以不是每个人都可以去读研究生，你必须参加这个考试并基本上通过它。

segments.en: So there's no pass fail, but certain schools will say that a score is high enough and other schools will say that a higher score is more important.
segments.zh: 所以没有通过失败，但某些学校会说分数足够高，其他学校会说分数越高越重要。

segments.en: So you can maybe go to a better school if you have a better score.
segments.zh: 所以如果你有更好的分数，你可以去一所更好的学校。

segments.en: Okay, and well, Mindy went on to explain the three parts of this test.
segments.zh: 好吧，Mindy 继续解释了这个测试的三个部分。

segments.en: The first one she said is analytical writing.
segments.zh: 她说的第一个是分析性写作。

segments.en: All right, so analytical writing is a very common part of a test.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以分析写作是测试中非常常见的部分。

segments.en: For example, I think the SAT also has analytical writing and basically you're asked to read something and then write about it.
segments.zh: 例如，我认为 SAT 也有分析性写作，基本上你被要求阅读一些东西然后写下它。

segments.en: And analytical means that you have to really use your mind to make an argument.
segments.zh: 分析意味着你必须真正用你的头脑进行论证。

segments.en: It's not just read and repeat, read and repeat.
segments.zh: 它不仅仅是阅读和重复，阅读和重复。

segments.en: So basically it comes from analyzing.
segments.zh: 所以基本上它来自分析。

segments.en: You analyze what you read and then you write about it.
segments.zh: 你分析你读到的东西，然后你写下来。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You have to think and you have to understand what you read and then you have to write something that makes sense.
segments.zh: 你必须思考，你必须理解你读到的东西，然后你必须写一些有意义的东西。

segments.en: It's logical.
segments.zh: 这是合乎逻辑的。

segments.en: Do you put your opinion in analytical writing?
segments.zh: 你把你的意见放在分析写作中吗？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: So it's all based on facts.
segments.zh: 所以这一切都基于事实。

segments.en: Based on facts and logic and argument.
segments.zh: 基于事实、逻辑和论证。

segments.en: Uh-huh, okay.
segments.zh: 嗯嗯，好吧。

segments.en: So you have this part of analytical writing.
segments.zh: 所以你有这部分分析写作。

segments.en: And then Mindy talks about the quantitative section of the test.
segments.zh: 然后 Mindy 谈到了测试的定量部分。

segments.en: So what is this?
segments.zh: 那么这是什么？

segments.en: So the quantitative section, you think of the word quantify, quantity, quantitative has to do with numbers.
segments.zh: 所以定量部分，你想到的是量化，数量，定量与数字有关。

segments.en: Math, basically.
segments.zh: 数学，基本上。

segments.en: So you have to be able to understand basic math, some algebra, some arithmetic, some statistics for example.
segments.zh: 所以你必须能够理解基本的数学、一些代数、一些算术、一些统计数据。

segments.en: So quantitative sections on tests are the math sections.
segments.zh: 因此，关于测试的定量部分是数学部分。

segments.en: Now from my understanding, even though it is a math section, it's not really like they give you a problem, an equation and you have to solve it.
segments.zh: 现在根据我的理解，即使它是一个数学部分，它们并不是真的给你一个问题，一个方程，你必须解决它。

segments.en: It's more like analysis, right?
segments.zh: 这更像是分析，对吧？

segments.en: They give you some information and you have to use math to solve it.
segments.zh: 他们给你一些信息，你必须使用数学来解决它。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So there are a number of different parts.
segments.zh: 所以有许多不同的部分。

segments.en: One of them is like what you say.
segments.zh: 其中之一就像你说的那样。

segments.en: It's kind of a, it's about logic while using algebra to solve these problems.
segments.zh: 它有点像，它是关于使用代数来解决这些问题的逻辑。

segments.en: I think the other part of it has to do with statistics and being able to understand trends, graphs, things like that.
segments.zh: 我认为它的另一部分与统计数据以及能够理解趋势、图表等有关。

segments.en: So this is the math section of the exam.
segments.zh: 所以这是考试的数学部分。

segments.en: So not only do you have to be able to read, understand and analyze what you're reading, you have to be able to be good at math.
segments.zh: 因此，您不仅必须能够阅读、理解和分析您正在阅读的内容，还必须能够擅长数学。

segments.en: And then finally we have a verbal section.
segments.zh: 最后我们有一个口头部分。

segments.en: What is this all about?
segments.zh: 这是怎么回事？

segments.en: This is about your English language and grammar skills.
segments.zh: 这是关于你的英语语言和语法技能。

segments.en: So the verbal section will test your vocabulary knowledge.
segments.zh: 因此，语言部分将测试您的词汇知识。

segments.en: Do you understand what big words mean?
segments.zh: 你明白大词的意思吗？

segments.en: Also will test your ability to read passages and analyze them.
segments.zh: 还将测试您阅读段落和分析它们的能力。

segments.en: So I guess this part is the most important, one of the most important parts for foreign students who obviously don't speak English as their first language.
segments.zh: 所以我想这部分是最重要的，对于那些显然不会以英语作为第一语言的外国学生来说是最重要的部分之一。

segments.en: This makes sure that you have a good enough English level to be able to take a graduate program in English, right?
segments.zh: 这可以确保您的英语水平足够好，可以参加英语研究生课程，对吧？

segments.en: Part of it's that there's a special test that will test your English abilities, but this is absolutely an important part for a non-native English speaker on the GMAT.
segments.zh: 部分原因是有一个特殊的测试可以测试你的英语能力，但这对于 GMAT 上的非英语母语人士来说绝对是一个重要的部分。

segments.en: You have to, it's hard for English speakers who were born speaking English, you know, natives English speakers.
segments.zh: 你必须这样做，对于天生说英语的说英语的人来说，这很难，你知道，会说英语的人。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's something that really you should devote your time to if you are a non-native English speaker because there will be some very challenging words there.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您是非英语母语人士，那么您真的应该把时间花在上面，因为那里会有一些非常具有挑战性的词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So those are the three sections of the GMAT.
segments.zh: 所以这些是 GMAT 的三个部分。

segments.en: And so to finish off language takeaway, Ash said that he's going to take this test because he wants to become a corporate fat cat.
segments.zh: 因此，为了完成语言外卖，Ash 说他将参加这项测试，因为他想成为一只企业肥猫。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now this is an interesting term.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个有趣的术语。

segments.en: This is not something we talk about in the office.
segments.zh: 这不是我们在办公室里谈论的事情。

segments.en: This is something we talk about with friends.
segments.zh: 这是我们与朋友谈论的事情。

segments.en: So corporate fat cat, you think corporate, corporation, this has to do with business.
segments.zh: 所以企业肥猫，你认为企业，公司，这与商业有关。

segments.en: So basically we're talking about very important businessmen, but fat cat's not a good thing, right?
segments.zh: 所以基本上我们在谈论非常重要的商人，但肥猫不是一件好事，对吧？

segments.en: No, it's not really.
segments.zh: 不，这不是真的。

segments.en: You refer to a fat cat, a corporate fat cat, as a businessman who you consider to have a lot of money, but obviously you make the analogy that they're fat because they have so much money.
segments.zh: 你指的是一只肥猫，一只企业肥猫，你认为它有很多钱，但显然你把它们的类比说成是它们很胖，因为它们有很多钱。

segments.en: And it's kind of a way of saying that businessmen are not the, corporate fat cats are not the best people around.
segments.zh: 这是一种说法，商人不是，企业肥猫不是周围最好的人。

segments.en: No, you're basically saying that these guys, these men on top, they're rich, but they're kind of lazy.
segments.zh: 不，你基本上是在说这些人，这些人，他们很富有，但他们有点懒惰。

segments.en: And so he wants to be a corporate fat cat.
segments.zh: 所以他想成为一只企业肥猫。

segments.en: He wants to be very rich and powerful and not have to work so hard.
segments.zh: 他想变得非常有钱和强大，而不必那么努力。

segments.en: Which obviously is not really the case always, but this is a common term that, as you said, you wouldn't really mention it in the office, but it's more of a satirical way of describing speaking about businessmen.
segments.zh: 这显然并非总是如此，但这是一个常见的术语，正如你所说，你不会在办公室里真正提及它，但它更像是一种讽刺描述商人的方式。

segments.en: All right, so now let's finish off language takeaway and move on to some phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在让我们完成语言外卖，继续学习 Fluency Builder 上的一些短语。

segments.en: I can't seem to progress up the career ladder no matter how hard I try.
segments.zh: 不管怎么努力，我的职位好像就是升不上去。

segments.en: And I have been here for two years already.
segments.zh: 我已经在这里两年了。

segments.en: Well, have you thought of getting an MBA?
segments.zh: 好吧，你想过要读MBA吗？

segments.en: I heard it does wonders in getting you to the top.
segments.zh: 我听说它确实让你登上了顶峰。

segments.en: An MBA, hey?
segments.zh: 工商管理硕士，是吗？

segments.en: Well, my degree wasn't in business.
segments.zh: 好吧，我的学位没有生意。

segments.en: The business schools won't be interested in me.
segments.zh: 商学院不会对我感兴趣。

segments.en: Nonsense.
segments.zh: 胡说。

segments.en: The business schools measure your ability through a test called GMAT.
segments.zh: 商学院通过称为 GMAT 的测试来衡量您的能力。

segments.en: GMAT?
segments.zh: GMAT考试？

segments.en: What does that stand for and what will the test contain?
segments.zh: 这代表什么，测试将包含什么？

segments.en: Graduate Management Admission Test.
segments.zh: 管理类研究生入学考试。

segments.en: It contains three parts, analytical writing assessment, the quantitative section, and the verbal section.
segments.zh: 它分为三部分：分析性写作、数学和语文。

segments.en: Not only does the test score you on the number of questions answered, but also on the difficulty.
segments.zh: 考试不仅在回答的问题数量上对您进行评分，而且在难度方面也得分。

segments.en: Okay, this sounds a little tough.
segments.zh: 好吧，这听起来有点难。

segments.en: How am I supposed to practice for this?
segments.zh: 我应该如何为此练习？

segments.en: Up to you.
segments.zh: 随你决定。

segments.en: You could have a one-on-one session with a tutor or group sessions.
segments.zh: 你可以请老师一对一辅导，也可以上小组课。

segments.en: You can also use free or private computer software.
segments.zh: 还可以用免费的或付费的电脑软件来练习。

segments.en: Going to church might help as well.
segments.zh: 去教堂也可能有帮助。

segments.en: No matter what I do, I'm going to ace this test and go on to become a corporate fat cat.
segments.zh: 不管用什么办法，我一定要考出好成绩，以后成为企业界的大亨。

segments.en: That's the spirit.
segments.zh: 这才对嘛。

segments.en: All right, in Fluency Builder today we have a number of really great phrases you can use.
segments.zh: 好吧，在 Fluency Builder 今天，我们有许多非常棒的短语，您可以使用。

segments.en: The first one is from Mindy.
segments.zh: 第一个来自明迪。

segments.en: She says, I heard it does wonders in getting you to the top.
segments.zh: 她说，我听说让你登上顶峰确实有奇迹。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: She suggests getting an MBA.
segments.zh: 她建议获得MBA学位。

segments.en: I heard it does wonders to improve your career.
segments.zh: 我听说改善你的职业生涯确实有奇迹。

segments.en: This is actually something that you might hear in a commercial.
segments.zh: 这实际上是您可能在广告中听到的内容。

segments.en: It does wonders means it really helps.
segments.zh: 它确实奇迹意味着它真的有帮助。

segments.en: It's really beneficial to you.
segments.zh: 这对你真的很有益。

segments.en: You might hear it in a commercial, for example, with a face cream.
segments.zh: 您可能会在广告中听到它，例如，使用面霜。

segments.en: It does wonders to your skin.
segments.zh: 它对你的皮肤有奇迹。

segments.en: It really makes your skin look good.
segments.zh: 它真的让你的皮肤看起来很好。

segments.en: By using this phrase, it does wonders, you're basically saying it's fast, it's effective, it's almost a miracle of how much it can improve your career or in this case of the cream, how it can improve your face.
segments.zh: 通过使用这句话，它确实奇迹，你基本上是说它很快，它是有效的，它几乎是一个奇迹，它可以改善你的职业生涯，或者在这种情况下，它可以如何改善你的脸部。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: The MBA does wonders.
segments.zh: MBA 创造奇迹。

segments.en: It's almost miraculous how positive and effective it will have on your career.
segments.zh: 它对你的职业生涯的积极性和有效性几乎是奇迹。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: It does wonders.
segments.zh: 它确实有奇迹。

segments.en: Then Ash was asking how he's supposed to study for this and Mindy answered, well, you know what?
segments.zh: 然后阿什问他应该如何为此学习，明迪回答，嗯，你知道吗？

segments.en: It's up to you.
segments.zh: 由你决定。

segments.en: You have a lot of options.
segments.zh: 你有很多选择。

segments.en: She said, up to you.
segments.zh: 她说，由你决定。

segments.en: Up to you.
segments.zh: 随你决定。

segments.en: This means it's your decision.
segments.zh: 这意味着这是你的决定。

segments.en: We can use this in normal life.
segments.zh: 我们可以在正常生活中使用它。

segments.en: You and I are out, Marco, and I say, well, I don't know what to eat.
segments.zh: 你和我出去了，马可，我说，好吧，我不知道吃什么。

segments.en: What do you want to eat?
segments.zh: 你想吃什么？

segments.en: I can say, oh, whatever.
segments.zh: 我可以说，哦，随便。

segments.en: It's up to you.
segments.zh: 由你决定。

segments.en: Up to me.
segments.zh: 由我决定。

segments.en: That means I get to decide what we eat and I want pizza.
segments.zh: 这意味着我可以决定我们吃什么，我想要披萨。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Up to you is a way to say, no, you decide.
segments.zh: 取决于你是一种说，不，你决定的方式。

segments.en: It's up to you.
segments.zh: 由你决定。

segments.en: It's your decision.
segments.zh: 这是你的决定。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: For our next phrase, Ash was saying that he's going to study really hard and he's going to ace the test.
segments.zh: 对于我们的下一个短语，Ash 说他会非常努力地学习，他将获得考试成绩。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now, to ace a test, this is a phrase that we use.
segments.zh: 现在，为了获得测试，这是我们使用的一个短语。

segments.en: We can use it in high school and college as well, not just MBA programs.
segments.zh: 我们也可以在高中和大学使用它，而不仅仅是 MBA 课程。

segments.en: To ace a test means to do perfectly on it.
segments.zh: 对测试来说，测试意味着完美地完成它。

segments.en: That means to get an A or even 100%.
segments.zh: 这意味着获得 A 甚至 100%。

segments.en: It's important to remember that we have this grading system, A, B, C, D, F. A is the top.
segments.zh: 重要的是要记住，我们有这个分级系统，A、B、C、D、F。A 是顶部。

segments.en: You ace it means you don't make any mistakes.
segments.zh: 你王牌这意味着你不会犯任何错误。

segments.en: Remember that, A for ace.
segments.zh: 记住，A for Ace。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: You can even use it if it's not really a test.
segments.zh: 如果它不是真正的测试，您甚至可以使用它。

segments.en: Like a job interview, you say, I aced that job interview.
segments.zh: 你说，就像求职面试一样，我在工作面试中取得了成功。

segments.en: I ace it.
segments.zh: 我王牌。

segments.en: In sports, oftentimes, we see this tennis.
segments.zh: 在体育运动中，我们经常看到这种网球。

segments.en: It's a sports analogy.
segments.zh: 这是一个体育类比。

segments.en: Tennis, when someone serves a ball and the other player can't even hit the ball back, it's an ace.
segments.zh: 网球，当有人送球而另一个球员甚至无法将球击回时，这是一个王牌。

segments.en: You get a point.
segments.zh: 你得到一个点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's an ace for that.
segments.zh: 这是一个王牌。

segments.en: Even good sports athletes, you call them aces.
segments.zh: 即使是优秀的运动运动员，你也称他们为王牌。

segments.en: After a job interview, I can say, wow, Marco, I really aced that interview.
segments.zh: 在一次工作面试之后，我可以说，哇，Marco，我真的在面试中取得了成功。

segments.en: I aced it.
segments.zh: 我打了它。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Mindy says, well, you know what?
segments.zh: 明迪说，好吧，你知道吗？

segments.en: That's really good.
segments.zh: 那真的很好。

segments.en: That's the spirit.
segments.zh: 这才对嘛。

segments.en: That's the spirit.
segments.zh: 这才对嘛。

segments.en: Now, this is something you say to someone when you like their attitude.
segments.zh: 现在，当你喜欢他们的态度时，这是你对某人说的话。

segments.en: If I say, oh man, I did really bad.
segments.zh: 如果我说，哦，伙计，我做得很糟糕。

segments.en: This is stupid.
segments.zh: 这太蠢了。

segments.en: I don't want to study.
segments.zh: 我不想学习。

segments.en: You say, well, that's a bad attitude.
segments.zh: 你说，嗯，这是一种不好的态度。

segments.en: If I say, you know what?
segments.zh: 如果我说，你知道吗？

segments.en: I'm going to do awesome.
segments.zh: 我会做的很棒。

segments.en: This is great.
segments.zh: 这太棒了。

segments.en: I'm going to kill this.
segments.zh: 我要杀了这个。

segments.en: I'm going to ace it.
segments.zh: 我要去演奏它。

segments.en: You can say, that's the spirit.
segments.zh: 你可以说，这就是精神。

segments.en: That's the spirit.
segments.zh: 这才对嘛。

segments.en: That means good attitude.
segments.zh: 这意味着良好的态度。

segments.en: That's the right way to think about this.
segments.zh: 这是思考这个问题的正确方式。

segments.en: So you're kind of even encouraging that person.
segments.zh: 所以你甚至有点鼓励那个人。

segments.en: You're saying, you know what?
segments.zh: 你说，你知道吗？

segments.en: I really like your attitude.
segments.zh: 我真的很喜欢你的态度。

segments.en: That's the good way of thinking.
segments.zh: 这是一种很好的思维方式。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So if you want to push someone and say, good for you.
segments.zh: 所以如果你想推别人说，对你有好处。

segments.en: This is a good way to approach it.
segments.zh: 这是处理它的好方法。

segments.en: You say, that's the spirit.
segments.zh: 你说，这就是精神。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Awesome.
segments.zh: 太棒了。

segments.en: So this is all the language that we have for Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们为 Fluency Builder 提供的所有语言。

segments.en: Why don't we take a break and we'll be right back.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不休息一下，我们会马上回来的。

segments.en: I can't seem to progress up the career ladder no matter how hard I try.
segments.zh: 不管怎么努力，我的职位好像就是升不上去。

segments.en: And I have been here for two years already.
segments.zh: 我已经在这里两年了。

segments.en: Well, have you thought of getting an MBA?
segments.zh: 好吧，你想过要读MBA吗？

segments.en: I heard it does wonders in getting you to the top.
segments.zh: 我听说它确实让你登上了顶峰。

segments.en: An MBA, hey?
segments.zh: 工商管理硕士，是吗？

segments.en: Well, my degree wasn't in business.
segments.zh: 好吧，我的学位没有生意。

segments.en: The business schools won't be interested in me.
segments.zh: 商学院不会对我感兴趣。

segments.en: Nonsense.
segments.zh: 胡说。

segments.en: The business schools measure your ability through a test called GMAT.
segments.zh: 商学院通过称为 GMAT 的测试来衡量您的能力。

segments.en: GMAT?
segments.zh: GMAT考试？

segments.en: What does that stand for?
segments.zh: 那代表什么？

segments.en: And what will the test contain?
segments.zh: 测试将包含什么？

segments.en: Graduate Management Admission Test.
segments.zh: 管理类研究生入学考试。

segments.en: It contains three parts.
segments.zh: 它包含三个部分。

segments.en: Analytical Writing Assessment, the Quantitative Section, and the Verbal Section.
segments.zh: 分析写作评估、定量部分和口头部分。

segments.en: Not only does the test score you on the number of questions answered, but also on the difficulty.
segments.zh: 考试不仅在回答的问题数量上对您进行评分，而且在难度方面也得分。

segments.en: Okay, this sounds a little tough.
segments.zh: 好吧，这听起来有点难。

segments.en: How am I supposed to practice for this?
segments.zh: 我应该如何为此练习？

segments.en: Up to you.
segments.zh: 随你决定。

segments.en: You could have a one-on-one session with a tutor or group sessions.
segments.zh: 你可以请老师一对一辅导，也可以上小组课。

segments.en: You can also use free or private computer software.
segments.zh: 还可以用免费的或付费的电脑软件来练习。

segments.en: Going to church might help as well.
segments.zh: 去教堂也可能有帮助。

segments.en: No matter what I do, I'm going to ace this test and go on to become a corporate fat cat.
segments.zh: 不管用什么办法，我一定要考出好成绩，以后成为企业界的大亨。

segments.en: That's the spirit.
segments.zh: 这才对嘛。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now talking about the GMAT and an MBA.
segments.zh: 所以现在谈论 GMAT 和 MBA。

segments.en: This seems to be a very popular topic nowadays.
segments.zh: 这似乎是当今一个非常流行的话题。

segments.en: Everyone wants to get obviously a good education and go to graduate school, which means getting your master's degree or your doctoral degree.
segments.zh: 每个人都希望获得良好的教育并进入研究生院，这意味着获得硕士学位或博士学位。

segments.en: What do you think about the GMAT and the MBA?
segments.zh: 您对 GMAT 和 MBA 有何看法？

segments.en: Is it a miracle worker like this girl says she does?
segments.zh: 它是像这个女孩说的那样的奇迹创造者吗？

segments.en: Wow, it does wonders for your career.
segments.zh: 哇，它对你的职业生涯有着奇迹。

segments.en: Do you think that's really the case?
segments.zh: 你认为真的是这样吗？

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: Maybe if you asked me five years ago, I would say yes.
segments.zh: 也许如果你五年前问我，我会说是的。

segments.en: But I really believe that it depends on the person.
segments.zh: 但我真的相信这取决于人。

segments.en: Nothing is a miracle cure.
segments.zh: 没有什么是奇迹疗法。

segments.en: I do think that if you really have a good attitude and you work hard, you'll get a lot out of it.
segments.zh: 我确实认为，如果你真的有一个很好的态度并且你努力工作，你会从中得到很多。

segments.en: But if you think it's going to get you a job, you're wrong because you have to get yourself a job.
segments.zh: 但如果你认为它会给你一份工作，那你就错了，因为你必须给自己找一份工作。

segments.en: So I think it depends on the person.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这取决于人。

segments.en: Now obviously also it depends on the country, right?
segments.zh: 现在显然也取决于国家，对吧？

segments.en: Now how popular or how important is it for people to have, let's say, an MBA to get ahead in business in the United States?
segments.zh: 现在，例如，MBA 在美国开展业务有多受欢迎或有多重要？

segments.en: I'd say it's pretty important.
segments.zh: 我会说这很重要。

segments.en: You don't have to have an MBA.
segments.zh: 你不必拥有MBA。

segments.en: I mean, you can start your own business.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你可以开始自己的事业。

segments.en: And if you're successful, you'll probably start more businesses.
segments.zh: 如果你成功了，你可能会开始更多的生意。

segments.en: But getting an MBA is also a very good opportunity to network, to meet people, to find out more about the industry that you want to start out in.
segments.zh: 但获得 MBA 也是一个很好的交流机会，结识人，了解更多你想开始的行业。

segments.en: And so I think in that sense, it's pretty important because it's a way to start making contacts.
segments.zh: 所以我认为从这个意义上说，这非常重要，因为它是开始建立联系的一种方式。

segments.en: Yeah, you definitely meet a lot of people with work experience from different backgrounds, international students.
segments.zh: 是的，你肯定会遇到很多来自不同背景的工作经验的人，国际学生。

segments.en: So it's obviously a great thing.
segments.zh: 所以这显然是一件很棒的事情。

segments.en: But obviously to be able to do one of these programs, like get an MBA, you have to take these tests, which I understand are very, very difficult.
segments.zh: 但显然要能够完成其中一个程序，比如获得 MBA 学位，你必须参加这些测试，我知道这非常非常困难。

segments.en: They are very difficult and it can be very expensive.
segments.zh: 它们非常困难，而且可能非常昂贵。

segments.en: I mean, graduate school itself is $100,000, $200,000.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，研究生院本身是 100,000 美元，200,000 美元。

segments.en: And then to prepare for the tests, you could spend another $1,000 just getting classes or tutoring.
segments.zh: 然后为了准备考试，你可以再花 1,000 美元来上课或辅导。

segments.en: So I do think that it can be a lot of money up front.
segments.zh: 所以我确实认为预先可能会有很多钱。

segments.en: But there are places that you can go to study and you could even study on your own using your computer.
segments.zh: 但是有些地方你可以去学习，甚至可以自己使用电脑学习。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: I think this is a very interesting topic because in many different cultures, in many different places, education or, for example, higher learning, like getting an MBA, has different levels of importance.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一个非常有趣的话题，因为在许多不同的文化中，在许多不同的地方，教育，或者，例如，高等教育，就像获得 MBA 学位一样，具有不同的重要性水平。

segments.en: Like in Europe, a lot of Europeans maybe don't really even pay too much attention to getting an MBA.
segments.zh: 就像在欧洲一样，很多欧洲人可能真的没有过多关注获得 MBA 学位。

segments.en: Whereas in other countries, they might really emphasize like you have to have an MBA.
segments.zh: 而在其他国家，他们可能真的像你必须拥有 MBA 一样强调。

segments.en: It's really good.
segments.zh: 真的很不错。

segments.en: It's really good for your career.
segments.zh: 这对你的职业真的很好。

segments.en: So it's very interesting to see how in different places they handle it.
segments.zh: 所以看到他们在不同的地方如何处理是非常有趣的。

segments.en: It is interesting.
segments.zh: 这很有趣。

segments.en: And I'm actually very curious to hear from our users.
segments.zh: 我真的很想听听我们的用户的意见。

segments.en: Have you ever thought about getting an MBA?
segments.zh: 你有没有想过获得MBA？

segments.en: Are MBAs important to do business in your country?
segments.zh: MBA 对在您的国家开展业务很重要吗？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Thank you.
segments.zh: 谢谢。
